The board of directors of each school district and the 14 authorities in charge of each accredited nonpublic school shall 15 immediately place an employee on administrative leave if any 16 of the following apply: 17 a. The employee has a case pending before the board of 18 educational examiners related to the abuse of a child with a 19 finding of probable cause. 20 b. While employed by the school district or accredited 21 nonpublic school, the employee was involved in any criminal 22 or civil action in which a court found that the employee was 23 negligent, and the school district or accredited nonpublic 24 school is investigating the employee’s actions. 25 2.
